answer: The quill is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the sparrow. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the crystal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
